|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)]] (version 3 of 4). The current text is [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Playtest''' ([[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Playtest)]]): the pre-release card image (5 March 2023)<ref name="ht-53a6001">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/53a600169f2a3fd1b105ba01f85cef84edcd22bd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/hires/icantbelievehesgone.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/53a600169f2a3fd1b105ba01f85cef84edcd22bd 53a6001] “Virtual Set 21 Preview Cards”, 5 March 2023.</ref> prints: “If Obi-Wan ‘communing,’ deploy on table. Once per battle, may activate 1 Force or add 1 to a just drawn destiny. Once per game, if a battle at a Tatooine site just ended, may ‘revive’ (return to that site from Lost Pile) a Rebel forfeited from that site this turn. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-6e6f7f7">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/6e6f7f712de07a2c02ddc5073e1b1bcc733f61be swccg-card-json commit 6e6f7f7] “Set 21 Preview and Errata” (5 March 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''Original''' ([[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)]]): the card image at official release (31 May 2023, for the PC's June 1, 2023 errata)<ref name="ht-b8af2d4">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/b8af2d419a63b6a0edcf32c2b298935e403013c3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/b8af2d419a63b6a0edcf32c2b298935e403013c3 b8af2d4] “June 1 2023 Errata”, 31 May 2023, for the PC's June 1, 2023 errata.</ref> prints: “If Obi-Wan ‘communing,’ deploy on table. Once per battle, may activate 1 Force or add 1 to a just drawn battle destiny. Once per game, if a battle at a Tatooine site just ended, may ‘revive’ (return to that site from Lost Pile) a Rebel forfeited from that site this turn. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-455d8da">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/455d8da14080ddaeae2c37e83860e010ae02ccec swccg-card-json commit 455d8da] “June 1 errata (small update)” (3 June 2023) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “a just drawn destiny” became “a just drawn battle destiny” (the word “battle” was added). The rest of the text is unchanged. This image prints the errata mark “E1”: the PC issued it as its June 1, 2023 errata of the preview card. On the wiki it is the original, because it is the image in place at the set’s official release (18 June 2023). The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [[Media:Virtual Set 21 June 2023 (recovered).pdf|Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition]] (eight pages; June 2023 printed footer; [[:File:Virtual Set 21 June 2023 (recovered).pdf|source details]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 6, file created 17 June 2023: “If Obi-Wan 'communing,' deploy on table. Once per battle, may activate 1 Force or add 1 to a just drawn battle destiny. Once per game, if a battle at a Tatooine site just ended, may 'revive' (return to that site from Lost Pile) a Rebel forfeited from that site this turn. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•I Can’t Believe He’s Gone”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)]] (published 31 May 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[I Can't Believe He's Gone]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints “E1”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the errata card image (21 December 2023, for the PC's December 2023 errata)<ref name="ht-74a6bd4">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/74a6bd4970fefd8f67cc9f58497e2d5a2545f6ee/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/hires/icantbelievehesgone.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/74a6bd4970fefd8f67cc9f58497e2d5a2545f6ee 74a6bd4] “Dec 2023 Errata”, 21 December 2023, for the PC's December 2023 errata.</ref> prints: “If Obi-Wan ‘communing,’ deploy on table. Once per battle involving a Rebel, may activate 1 Force or add 1 to a just drawn battle destiny. Once per game, may ▲ (or retrieve) Old Ben. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-8d3b539">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/8d3b539101d70f08c5f6e9d812f8b8d4e5a61524 swccg-card-json commit 8d3b539] “Set 23 Preview and December 2023 Errata” (21 December 2023) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “Once per battle” became “Once per battle involving a Rebel”, and the whole revive sentence (“Once per game, if a battle at a Tatooine site just ended, may ‘revive’ (return to that site from Lost Pile) a Rebel forfeited from that site this turn.”) was replaced by “Once per game, may ▲ (or retrieve) Old Ben.” (▲ = take into hand from Reserve Deck and reshuffle; the PC card data writes it out as “take Old Ben into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or retrieve Old Ben”). The image prints “E2” (the PC counts the pre-release June 2023 change); on the wiki it is the first errata after release, PC-E2. The card image prints the errata mark “E2” at bottom right.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250926000921/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>, page 6, file created 30 December 2023: “If Obi-Wan 'communing,' deploy on table. Once per battle involving a Rebel, may activate 1 Force or add 1 to a just drawn battle destiny. Once per game, may ▲ (or retrieve) Old Ben. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•I Can’t Believe He’s Gone”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata 2)]] (published 21 December 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[I Can't Believe He's Gone]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings).
